licence: © European Union Aviation Safety Agency. "Reproduction is authorised, provided the source is acknowledged, save where otherwise stated." (https://www.easa.europa.eu/copyright-disclaimer)
notes: Levels and limits are those approved by EASA and recorded in the Type-Certificate Data Sheets for Noise; limits depend on MTOM, number of engines and the Annex 16 Volume I chapter.
This file is a reduced extract (see "reduction" in each set); the full databases list every approved mass/modification configuration and should be consulted for a specific aircraft.
null = not recorded for that configuration. Text fields are as written in the source.
